rules: Only two eligible adult participants may form one Step-10 date plan.
One participant must be the player in Step 10.
Player-origin invitations require explicit player request.
NPC-origin invitations require authoritative NPC romantic-interest state toward player.
Recipient response is independent from initiator desire.
Both participants need compatible schedule windows.
Venue capability and travel feasibility are required for both participants.
Overlapping date plans for either participant are invalid.
Completed date requires runtime attendance/completion evidence and cannot be fabricated from the plan.
